snippet.title: Always | Harry Potter and the Deathly Hallows Part 2 Pt. 2 ft. Amy Nicholson & Tom Felton
snippet.description:
A final secret revealed, a hero prepared to die, and an overlooked Gryffindor stepping forward when all hope seems lost. After eight films, the Battle of Hogwarts reaches its devastating conclusion.

Host Rhianna Dhillon is joined once again by film critic Amy Nicholson to look back at the second half of Harry Potter and the Deathly Hallows Part 2. Together, they unpack the revelation of Snape’s memories, Harry’s walk into the Forbidden Forest, Neville’s heroic stand against Voldemort, Molly Weasley’s unforgettable duel with Bellatrix, and the final battle that brings the saga to an end. 

Tom Felton joins to reflect on behind-the-scenes memories and his twenty-five-year-long relationship with Draco Malfoy. Plus, Art Director Gary Tomkins reveals what it took to reimagine the boathouse for Snape’s final moments and design the destruction of the Battle of Hogwarts.The Harry Potter: Complete 8-Film Collection is available on Blu-ray and Digital now.

snippet.title: The Unknown We Fear | Harry Potter and the Half-Blood Prince Pt. 2 ft. Law Sharma
snippet.description:
A love potion gone horribly wrong, a funeral powered by Felix Felicis, and a dramatic death that leaves our heroes without their Headmaster—this year at Hogwarts ends with romance, revelations, and one of the series’ most devastating betrayals.

Host Rhianna Dhillon is joined once again by Law Sharma to look back at the second half of Harry Potter and the Half-Blood Prince. Together, they unpack Slughorn’s Christmas party, Draco’s heartbreaking unraveling, the long-awaited Horcrux reveal, and the devastating death of Dumbledore on the Astronomy Tower.

Plus, Art Director Martin Foley joins to reveal how the art department grounded the wizarding world in real materials, textures, architecture, and practical sets.

Watch the complete Harry Potter 8-Film Collection on HBO Max.
